rationale: Both candidates independently found the same core technical bug (fork_rng's device_type defaults to 'cuda' so non-CUDA devices never get their RNG state properly restored) and the same allowlist-scope concern and FL2VA/Ref2VA copy-paste bug in the recipe, which loosely tracks the ground-truth reviewers' scope debate — but neither candidate found gcanlin's specific 'use current_omni_platform.device' suggestion or the UT-reduction thread, so recall is modest for both. X is more thorough and useful: it adds grounded follow-on findings (recipe overstating the RNG-restore claim, missing/mismatched test file, several concrete nits) with clean structure and copy-pasteable fixes for every blocking item. Y covers similar core ground but is padded with garbled leaked tool-narration text before the actual review, which hurts readability and actionability without adding content.
